_comment: Run template for synthetic-ahu-maintenance (generated by CAMBER, no real building): one constant-volume air handler's filter and cooling-valve loop, at the trend's own 5-minute resolution and the rules' defaults. filter_fouling reads the median filter differential pressure over the whole run (FLT_DP; warn at 1.0 in. w.c., fault at 1.5); control_hunting counts the cooling valve's direction reversals beyond a 5 % deadband per observed hour (CLG_VLV; warn at 6, fault at 12). Both read every sample, fan off included: the unit runs 05:00-21:00, and with the fan off the filter transmitter reads about zero and the valve is shut. Measured: AHU__dirty faults on filter_fouling (median 1.67 in. w.c.); AHU__loading passes it (median 0.70, though its filter crosses 1.0 in the second week); AHU__hunting warns on control_hunting (7.24 reversals an hour; fault is out of reach at 5 minutes, which can show at most 12); AHU__near_miss passes it (3.65); AHU__healthy passes both. Resampled to 10 minutes the hunting cycle is averaged away (0.08 an hour, ok); at 15 minutes control_hunting declines (info). Keep resample at 5min.
